Quick answers

Why the wait?

Email tools often approve new accounts before sending to outside addresses. It can take a day or more, and the checklist tells you what to do meanwhile.

Will my emails hit the inbox?

Nobody can promise that. The prompt sets up the records that give you the best honest shot.
